treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Moldova and the Portuguese Republic for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2009, with Protocol)
eif_quote: [MD MoF list, status 20.06.2022] Republica Portugheză | Convenția | 11.02.2009, Lisabona | 18.10.2010 | 01.01.2011 (signed | entry into force | date of application)
source_title: MD MoF English text of the MD–PT Convention (Portugalia_eng.pdf) and Protocol (Protocol_Portugalia_eng.pdf)

rates.quote: the tax so charged shall not exceed: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 8 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: treaty Protocol para 2(c) (main-purpose rule for creation/assignment of property or rights; not an MLI-style PPT)
ppt.quote: c) The provisions of the Convention shall not apply if it was the main purpose or one of the main purposes of any person concerned with the creation or assignment of the property or right in respect of which the income is paid to take advantage of those provisions by means of such creation or assignment.

notes: Art. 11(3): interest paid to, or on loans made/guaranteed/insured by, a Contracting State, its Government, subdivisions or Central Bank taxable only in residence State (not modelled). Protocol para 2: domestic anti-avoidance rules preserved; benefits denied to non-beneficial owners; main-purpose rule for creation/assignment of property or rights (recorded under ppt). Art. 28: EIF 30 days after later notification; WHT effect from 1 January following EIF (2010 -> 2011-01-01). Moldova not an MLI signatory.
